title.zh: 三阱隔离：底部与侧边都要闭合
title.en: Triple-well isolation: close both bottom and sides

subtitle.zh: 深部N型区域、侧向边界与PN结隔离
subtitle.en: Deep N-type region, lateral boundaries and PN-junction isolation

body.zh: 局部P阱与P型衬底分开，既要有深部N型区域，也要有完整侧向隔离与正确偏置。横截面标注局部P阱、N型隔离区域（深N阱）、N型侧向连接、N⁺深N阱接触及P型衬底；俯视图中N型围合区域由深N阱加侧向N阱组成，围住局部P阱并设N⁺接触。
body.en: Separating a local P-well from the P substrate requires a deep N-type region, complete lateral isolation and correct bias. The cross-section labels local P-well, deep N-well isolation, lateral N-type connections, N⁺ deep-well contacts and P substrate. In top view, deep N-well plus lateral N-well encloses the local P-well and includes N⁺ contacts.

body.zh: 在结构及版图定义阶段，将隔离目标落实为可制造、可接触的阱区。圈定局部P阱 → 检查深部隔离 → 检查侧向闭合 → 核对包围及间距 → 提取阱区网络。控制底部与侧向连续性、掩膜包围关系、阱间距和接触可达性。
body.en: During structure/layout definition, realize isolation as manufacturable, contactable wells. Define local P-well → check deep isolation → check lateral closure → verify enclosure/spacing → extract well network. Control bottom/lateral continuity, mask enclosure, well spacing and contact accessibility.

body.zh: 放大隔离区域可能增加布局余量，也增加面积及相关结寄生，不能靠扩大DNW图形替代规则检查。常见失效：包围不足、非预期阱区连通、把截面闭合误当成整个平面均已闭合。
body.en: Larger isolation regions may add layout margin but also area and junction parasitics. Enlarging DNW shapes does not replace rule checks. Common failures include inadequate enclosure, unintended well connectivity and assuming a closed cross-section proves closure across the entire plane.

body.zh: 版图用DRC与LVS核对几何及网络；硅后以隔离测试结构检查结漏电，异常后复核边界与工艺实现。这影响局部体区能否按设计偏置，以及后续噪声耦合路径。本页以深N阱配合侧向N阱围合为例，实际掩膜组合、包围方向和连接关系以所用PDK为准。
body.en: Use DRC/LVS to check layout geometry and networks. After fabrication, use isolation test structures for junction leakage and review boundaries/process realization after anomalies. This affects intended local-body bias and later noise-coupling paths. Deep N-well plus lateral N-well is an example; actual masks, enclosure directions and connections follow the applicable PDK.

uncertain: 原图右下方水印与页底图文区域重叠；保留完整图表时不能仅靠矩形裁剪无损去除，未猜补被覆盖像素。 / The lower-right watermark overlaps the lower-page content region; a rectangular crop cannot remove it while preserving every diagram. Covered pixels have not been reconstructed.
